# Formlinc

> Formlinc lets you build beautiful forms, share a link, and sync every submission straight into your own Google Sheet in real time.

Formlinc is a SaaS tool for marketers, founders, and operators who want a fast way to collect responses without wiring up Zapier or writing glue code. Create a form, share the public link, and every submission lands in your Google Sheet automatically.
